statements.impact_statement: The component pkg:rpm/redhat/sqlite-libs@3.34.1-10.el9_8 is absent from the final image rpmdb and rootfs. The exact retained-payload trim and absence gates in images/python/tools/build-python-rootfs.py and images/python/tools/run-python-gates.sh prove that libsqlite3, the CPython _sqlite3 extension, its sqlite3 stdlib package directory, and its build-id link are also absent. Therefore the component is not present in this product.
